partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Disease-causing chemical clearance activation
results.hypothesis: Activating an enzyme that consumes a non-drug chemical represented as causing disease may increase clearance of that chemical.
results.body: Disease-causing non-drug chemical is an enzyme substrate; drug directly binds and increases enzyme activity or abundance
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule encodes graph-contained chemical clearance direction, but ChEMBL substrate status does not guarantee metabolic consumption and SemMedDB causation may represent endogenous mediators.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif is TRAPI-expressible; negative category constraint, provenance, direction, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (enzyme:Gene)-[substrate:HAS_SUBSTRATE]->(chemical:ChemicalEntity)
      -[etiology:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(enzyme)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(enzyme)
WHERE NOT chemical:Drug
  AND subject <> chemical
  AND 'infores:chembl' IN
      coalesce(substrate.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:semmeddb' IN
      coalesce(etiology.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Disease-causing chemical clearance inhibition control
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting the same enzyme is a matched control expected to reduce clearance of the disease-causing chemical.
results.body: R419 with decreased rather than increased enzyme activity or abundance
results.mechanism_rationale: The same chemical and enzyme architecture is retained while the drug direction opposes clearance.
